name: call_inside_function_rejected
source:
{ Error parity: a CALL inside a FOR within a FUNCTION has no procedural meaning
  and must raise a clear error rather than be silently skipped.
  Java callInsideProcedureForIsRejectedNotSilentlyDropped. }
FUNCTION Bad(n)
  FOR i = 1 TO n
    CALL pole(i, i : a, b)
  END
  Bad := 1
END

y = Bad(2)

error.message: CALL is not supported inside a FOR loop within a PROCEDURE or FUNCTION (offending call: 'pole').
